template:
openapi: 3.1.0

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# SeniorSocial MVP API contract SKELETON.
#
# This document fixes paths, methods, status codes and SCHEMA NAMES. It does
# NOT carry full validation detail: the zod schemas in packages/contracts are
# the runtime source and GENERATE the shipped OpenAPI document. The contract
# test layer asserts that the generated document still matches this one.
#
# Change rule: integrator only, via a ruled docket. Additive only after T+20.
# See README.md in this folder.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

info:
  title: SeniorSocial API
  version: 1.0.0-mvp
  summary: White-label city connection and services platform for residents 60+
  description: >
    Every operational resource is scoped by org_id and every response is scoped
    to the caller's organisation. Cross-org access returns 404, never 403, so
    that the existence of another organisation's records is not disclosed.
    All people in every environment of this API are synthetic.
  license:
    name: Proprietary - white label
x-contract-version: 2
x-owner: WP-002 (integrator)

servers:
  - url: /api/v1
    description: Versioned REST surface inside the single Next.js deployable

tags:
  - name: health
    description: Liveness and readiness. Unauthenticated.
  - name: auth
    description: Passwordless sign-in, demo-code sign-in, sessions. (WP-004)
  - name: me
    description: The caller's own profile, preferences, mode and language. (WP-007, WP-009)
  - name: services
    description: Services directory search and staff CRUD. (WP-010)
  - name: concierge
    description: Grounded natural-language service discovery. (WP-011)
  - name: events
    description: Events, RSVP, waitlist, recommendations, resident proposals. (WP-012)
  - name: rides
    description: Ride requests, state transitions, staff dispatch queue. (WP-013)
  - name: assistance
    description: Priority Assistance requests, triage, staff queue, SLA. (WP-014)
  - name: forums
    description: Topics, posts, replies, report, block, moderation queue. (WP-015)
  - name: messages
    description: One-to-one conversations. (WP-016)
  - name: caregiver
    description: Invitations, item-by-item consent scopes, revocation. (WP-017)
  - name: intake
    description: Legal intake and health navigation forms and routing. (WP-018)
  - name: notifications
    description: Inbox, preferences, quiet hours, printable schedule. (WP-009)
  - name: admin
    description: Users, content, FAQs, announcements, partners, queues. (WP-019)
  - name: reports
    description: Reporting and scoped open-format export. (WP-020)
  - name: translations
    description: Translation assist and version-linked review queue. (WP-021)
  - name: ai-admin
    description: Feature flags, AI kill switches, AI event log. (WP-006, WP-008)
  - name: audit
    description: Audit event log. (WP-006)

security:
  - sessionCookie: []

paths:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------- health --
  /healthz:
    get:
      tags: [health]
      operationId: liveness
      summary: Liveness probe
      security: []
      responses:
        '200': { description: alive, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/HealthStatus' } } } }
  /readyz:
    get:
      tags: [health]
      operationId: readiness
      summary: Readiness probe - gates Railway Active
      security: []
      responses:
        '200': { description: ready, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/HealthStatus' } } } }
        '503': { description: not ready, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/HealthStatus' } } } }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------ auth --
  /auth/magic-link:
    post:
      tags: [auth]
      operationId: requestMagicLink
      summary: Email a sign-in link
      security: []
      requestBody: { required: true, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/MagicLinkRequest' } } } }
      responses:
        '202': { description: accepted - response is identical whether or not the address is known }
        '429': { $ref: '#/components/responses/RateLimited' }
  /auth/sms-code:
    post:
      tags: [auth]
      operationId: requestSmsCode
      summary: Send a 6-digit code by SMS or to the simulator
      security: []
      requestBody: { required: true, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/SmsCodeRequest' } } } }
      responses:
        '202': { description: accepted }
        '429': { $ref: '#/components/responses/RateLimited' }
  /auth/verify:
    post:
      tags: [auth]
      operationId: verifyCredential
      summary: Exchange a link token or SMS code for a session
      security: []
      requestBody: { required: true, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/VerifyRequest' } } } }
      responses:
        '200': { description: session established, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Session' } } } }
        '401': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Unauthorized' }
        '429': { $ref: '#/components/responses/RateLimited' }
  /auth/demo-code:
    post:
      tags: [auth]
      operationId: demoCodeSignIn
      summary: Reviewer sign-in with a time-limited demo code
      security: []
      requestBody: { required: true, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/DemoCodeRequest' } } } }
      responses:
        '200': { description: session established, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Session' } } } }
        '401': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Unauthorized' }
        '410': { description: demo account expired, content: { application/problem+json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem' } } } }
  /auth/logout:
    post:
      tags: [auth]
      operationId: logout
      summary: End the session
      responses:
        '204': { description: ended }

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------- me --
  /me:
    get:
      tags: [me]
      operationId: getMe
      summary: The caller's identity, roles, org and active scopes
      responses:
        '200': { description: OK, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Me' } } } }
        '401': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Unauthorized' }
  /me/profile:
    get:
      tags: [me]
      operationId: getProfile
      summary: The caller's profile
      responses:
        '200': { description: OK, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Profile' } } } }
    patch:
      tags: [me]
      operationId: updateProfile
      summary: Update the caller's profile
      requestBody: { required: true, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProfilePatch' } } } }
      responses:
        '200': { description: updated, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Profile' } } } }
        '422': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Unprocessable' }
  /me/preferences:
    get:
      tags: [me]
      operationId: getPreferences
      summary: Mode, language, channels, quiet hours, no-outbound choice
      responses:
        '200': { description: OK, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Preferences' } } } }
    put:
      tags: [me]
      operationId: replacePreferences
      summary: Replace preferences - a required task notice may not be switched off by an unrelated change
      requestBody: { required: true, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Preferences' } } } }
      responses:
        '200': { description: replaced, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Preferences' } } } }
        '422': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Unprocessable' }
  /me/caregivers:
    get:
      tags: [caregiver]
      operationId: listMyCaregivers
      summary: Who may act for me and on exactly what
      responses:
        '200': { description: OK, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/CaregiverLinkPage' } } } }

  # -------------------------------------------------------------- services --
  /services:
    get:
      tags: [services]
      operationId: searchServices
      summary: Search the directory by plain-language query, category, language and accessibility
      parameters:
        - { name: q, in: query, schema: { type: string } }
        - { name: category, in: query, schema: { type: string } }
        - { name: locale, in: query, schema: { type: string, enum: [en, es] } }
        - { $ref: '#/components/parameters/Cursor' }
        - { $ref: '#/components/parameters/Limit' }
      responses:
        '200': { description: OK, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/ServicePage' } } } }
  /services/{serviceId}:
    parameters: [{ $ref: '#/components/parameters/ServiceId' }]
    get:
      tags: [services]
      operationId: getService
      summary: One directory record
      responses:
        '200': { description: OK, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Service' } } } }
        '404': { $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound' }
  /service-categories:
    get:
      tags: [services]
      operationId: listServiceCategories
      summary: City-approved categories
      responses:
        '200': { description: OK, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/ServiceCategoryPage' } } } }
  /admin/services:
    post:
      tags: [services, admin]
      operationId: createService
      summary: Staff create a directory record
      requestBody: { required: true, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/ServiceInput' } } } }
      responses:
        '201': { description: created, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Service' } } } }
        '403': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Forbidden' }
        '422': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Unprocessable' }
  /admin/services/{serviceId}:
    parameters: [{ $ref: '#/components/parameters/ServiceId' }]
    patch:
      tags: [services, admin]
      operationId: updateService
      summary: Staff edit a directory record - audited
      requestBody: { required: true, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/ServiceInput' } } } }
      responses:
        '200': { description: updated, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Service' } } } }
        '403': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Forbidden' }
        '404': { $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound' }
  /admin/services/import:
    post:
      tags: [services, admin]
      operationId: importServicesCsv
      summary: Staff CSV import - never fabricates provider acceptance; rejected rows are reported
      requestBody: { required: true, content: { multipart/form-data: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/CsvUpload' } } } }
      responses:
        '200': { description: import result, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/ImportResult' } } } }
        '403': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Forbidden' }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------- concierge --
  /concierge/conversations:
    post:
      tags: [concierge]
      operationId: startConciergeConversation
      summary: Open a grounded assistance conversation
      responses:
        '201': { description: created, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/ConciergeConversation' } } } }
        '503': { $ref: '#/components/responses/AiDisabled' }
  /concierge/conversations/{conversationId}:
    parameters: [{ $ref: '#/components/parameters/ConversationId' }]
    get:
      tags: [concierge]
      operationId: getConciergeConversation
      summary: Transcript with the citations each answer used
      responses:
        '200': { description: OK, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/ConciergeConversation' } } } }
        '404': { $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound' }
  /concierge/conversations/{conversationId}/messages:
    parameters: [{ $ref: '#/components/parameters/ConversationId' }]
    post:
      tags: [concierge]
      operationId: sendConciergeMessage
      summary: Ask a question - answers cite directory records or decline
      requestBody: { required: true, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/ConciergeMessageInput' } } } }
      responses:
        '200': { description: answered, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/ConciergeAnswer' } } } }
        '429': { $ref: '#/components/responses/RateLimited' }
        '503': { $ref: '#/components/responses/AiDisabled' }
  /concierge/conversations/{conversationId}/handoff:
    parameters: [{ $ref: '#/components/parameters/ConversationId' }]
    post:
      tags: [concierge, assistance]
      operationId: conciergeHandoff
      summary: Talk to a person - opens a real assistance request; available with AI off
      security:
        - sessionCookie: []
      responses:
        '201': { description: assistance request opened, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/AssistanceRequest' } } } }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------- events --
  /events:
    get:
      tags: [events]
      operationId: listEvents
      summary: Upcoming events as a list - Easy Mode never renders a calendar grid
      parameters:
        - { name: from, in: query, schema: { type: string, format: date } }
        - { name: to, in: query, schema: { type: string, format: date } }
        - { $ref: '#/components/parameters/Cursor' }
        - { $ref: '#/components/parameters/Limit' }
      responses:
        '200': { description: OK, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/EventPage' } } } }
  /events/{eventId}:
    parameters: [{ $ref: '#/components/parameters/EventId' }]
    get:
      tags: [events]
      operationId: getEvent
      summary: One event
      responses:
        '200': { description: OK, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Event' } } } }
        '404': { $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound' }
  /events/{eventId}/rsvp:
    parameters: [{ $ref: '#/components/parameters/EventId' }]
    post:
      tags: [events]
      operationId: createRsvp
      summary: RSVP - race-safe at capacity; a full event returns 409 and offers the waitlist
      responses:
        '201': { description: attending, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Rsvp' } } } }
        '409': { description: at capacity, content: { application/problem+json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem' } } } }
    delete:
      tags: [events]
      operationId: cancelRsvp
      summary: Cancel an RSVP - promotes the first waitlisted person
      responses:
        '204': { description: cancelled }
  /events/{eventId}/waitlist:
    parameters: [{ $ref: '#/components/parameters/EventId' }]
    post:
      tags: [events]
      operationId: joinWaitlist
      summary: Join the waitlist
      responses:
        '201': { description: waitlisted, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Rsvp' } } } }
  /event-proposals:
    post:
      tags: [events]
      operationId: proposeEvent
      summary: A resident proposes an event - stays unpublished until staff publish it
      requestBody: { required: true, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/EventProposalInput' } } } }
      responses:
        '201': { description: proposed, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/EventProposal' } } } }
  /recommendations/events:
    get:
      tags: [events]
      operationId: recommendEvents
      summary: Rules-based recommendations; AI re-ranking is flag-gated and off by default
      responses:
        '200': { description: OK, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/EventPage' } } } }

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------- rides --
  /rides:
    get:
      tags: [rides]
      operationId: listMyRides
      summary: My ride requests with their truthful states
      responses:
        '200': { description: OK, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/RideRequestPage' } } } }
    post:
      tags: [rides]
      operationId: createRideRequest
      summary: Request a ride - a failed send leaves the request saved and unsent, never booked
      requestBody: { required: true, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/RideRequestInput' } } } }
      responses:
        '201': { description: saved, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/RideRequest' } } } }
        '403': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Forbidden' }
        '422': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Unprocessable' }
  /rides/{rideId}:
    parameters: [{ $ref: '#/components/parameters/RideId' }]
    get:
      tags: [rides]
      operationId: getRideRequest
      summary: One ride request with its accessibility conditions preserved verbatim
      responses:
        '200': { description: OK, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/RideRequest' } } } }
        '404': { $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound' }
  /rides/{rideId}/transitions:
    parameters: [{ $ref: '#/components/parameters/RideId' }]
    post:
      tags: [rides]
      operationId: transitionRide
      summary: Move the state machine - records actor and time; an illegal transition is 409
      requestBody: { required: true, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/RideTransitionInput' } } } }
      responses:
        '200': { description: transitioned, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/RideRequest' } } } }
        '409': { description: illegal transition, content: { application/problem+json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem' } } } }
  /staff/rides:
    get:
      tags: [rides, admin]
      operationId: listRideQueue
      summary: Dispatcher queue - rendered by the admin dashboard from this contract
      responses:
        '200': { description: OK, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/RideRequestPage' } } } }
        '403': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Forbidden' }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------ assistance --
  /assistance-requests:
    get:
      tags: [assistance]
      operationId: listMyAssistanceRequests
      summary: My Priority Assistance requests
      responses:
        '200': { description: OK, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/AssistanceRequestPage' } } } }
    post:
      tags: [assistance]
      operationId: createAssistanceRequest
      summary: Press the button - an unowned request shows explicit pending and promises no callback time
      requestBody: { required: true, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/AssistanceRequestInput' } } } }
      responses:
        '201': { description: created, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/AssistanceRequest' } } } }
  /assistance-requests/{requestId}:
    parameters: [{ $ref: '#/components/parameters/RequestId' }]
    get:
      tags: [assistance]
      operationId: getAssistanceRequest
      summary: One request with its owner if it has one and its SLA clock
      responses:
        '200': { description: OK, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/AssistanceRequest' } } } }
        '404': { $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound' }
  /assistance-requests/{requestId}/transitions:
    parameters: [{ $ref: '#/components/parameters/RequestId' }]
    post:
      tags: [assistance]
      operationId: transitionAssistanceRequest
      summary: Assign an owner or change state - audited with actor and time
      requestBody: { required: true, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/AssistanceTransitionInput' } } } }
      responses:
        '200': { description: transitioned, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/AssistanceRequest' } } } }
        '403': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Forbidden' }
        '409': { description: illegal transition, content: { application/problem+json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem' } } } }
  /staff/assistance-requests:
    get:
      tags: [assistance, admin]
      operationId: listAssistanceQueue
      summary: Staff queue ordered by SLA clock
      responses:
        '200': { description: OK, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/AssistanceRequestPage' } } } }
        '403': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Forbidden' }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------- forums --
  /forums/topics:
    get:
      tags: [forums]
      operationId: listTopics
      summary: Topics
      responses:
        '200': { description: OK, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/ForumTopicPage' } } } }
  /forums/topics/{topicId}/posts:
    parameters: [{ $ref: '#/components/parameters/TopicId' }]
    get:
      tags: [forums]
      operationId: listPosts
      summary: Posts in a topic - a blocked user's posts are absent, not greyed
      responses:
        '200': { description: OK, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/ForumPostPage' } } } }
    post:
      tags: [forums]
      operationId: createPost
      summary: Post - an AI flag never hides content without a human decision
      requestBody: { required: true, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/ForumPostInput' } } } }
      responses:
        '201': { description: created, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/ForumPost' } } } }
        '429': { $ref: '#/components/responses/RateLimited' }
  /forums/posts/{postId}/replies:
    parameters: [{ $ref: '#/components/parameters/PostId' }]
    post:
      tags: [forums]
      operationId: createReply
      summary: Reply
      requestBody: { required: true, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/ForumReplyInput' } } } }
      responses:
        '201': { description: created, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/ForumReply' } } } }
  /forums/posts/{postId}/report:
    parameters: [{ $ref: '#/components/parameters/PostId' }]
    post:
      tags: [forums]
      operationId: reportPost
      summary: Report content to the human moderation queue
      requestBody: { required: true, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/ReportInput' } } } }
      responses:
        '201': { description: reported, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Report' } } } }
  /blocks:
    post:
      tags: [forums]
      operationId: blockUser
      summary: Block a person everywhere in the product
      requestBody: { required: true, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/BlockInput' } } } }
      responses:
        '201': { description: blocked }
    get:
      tags: [forums]
      operationId: listBlocks
      summary: Who I have blocked
      responses:
        '200': { description: OK, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/BlockPage' } } } }
  /staff/moderation-queue:
    get:
      tags: [forums, admin]
      operationId: listModerationQueue
      summary: Flags and reports awaiting a human decision
      responses:
        '200': { description: OK, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/ModerationItemPage' } } } }
        '403': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Forbidden' }
  /staff/moderation-queue/{itemId}/decision:
    parameters: [{ $ref: '#/components/parameters/ItemId' }]
    post:
      tags: [forums, admin]
      operationId: decideModerationItem
      summary: A human decides - the decision and its reason are audited
      requestBody: { required: true, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/ModerationDecisionInput' } } } }
      responses:
        '200': { description: decided, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/ModerationItem' } } } }
        '403': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Forbidden' }

  # -------------------------------------------------------------- messages --
  /conversations:
    get:
      tags: [messages]
      operationId: listConversations
      summary: My conversations
      responses:
        '200': { description: OK, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/ConversationPage' } } } }
    post:
      tags: [messages]
      operationId: createConversation
      summary: Start a one-to-one conversation
      requestBody: { required: true, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/ConversationInput' } } } }
      responses:
        '201': { description: created, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Conversation' } } } }
        '403': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Forbidden' }
  /conversations/{conversationId}/messages:
    parameters: [{ $ref: '#/components/parameters/ConversationId' }]
    get:
      tags: [messages]
      operationId: listMessages
      summary: Messages - visible only to participants; a non-participant gets 404
      responses:
        '200': { description: OK, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/MessagePage' } } } }
        '404': { $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound' }
    post:
      tags: [messages]
      operationId: sendMessage
      summary: Send a message
      requestBody: { required: true, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/MessageInput' } } } }
      responses:
        '201': { description: sent, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Message' } } } }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------- caregiver --
  /caregiver/invitations:
    post:
      tags: [caregiver]
      operationId: inviteCaregiver
      summary: Invite someone to help - the invitation grants nothing until the resident consents item by item
      requestBody: { required: true, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/CaregiverInviteInput' } } } }
      responses:
        '201': { description: invited, content: { application/json: { schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/CaregiverInvitation' } } } }
  /caregiver/invitations/{token}/accept:
    parameters: [{ name: token, in: path, required: true, schema: { type: string } }]
    post:
      tags: [caregiver]
      operationId: acceptCaregiverInvitation
